name: Monetary poverty headcount rate
definition: Share of people living in households whose consumption per adult equivalent is below the national poverty line (EICV7, January 2024 prices).
notes: Monetary poverty and MPI incidence are different concepts and must not be compared as if interchangeable.

name: Extreme poverty headcount rate
definition: Share of people whose consumption per adult equivalent is below the extreme (food) poverty line.

name: Poverty rate 2017 (modelled, comparable)
definition: EICV5 (2016/17) poverty rate re-estimated by NISR on the EICV7 methodology via an OLS consumption model with multiple imputation, so that 2017→2024 change is comparable.
notes: Modelled baseline, not the originally published EICV5 rate.

name: Poverty rate (Poverty Profile table, 1-decimal)
definition: Monetary poverty headcount as printed in the Poverty Profile tables (rounded). Urban/rural in Table 5.2 use the 2012 urban definition.
notes: Urban/rural rows here use the 2012 urban/rural definitions and differ from Table 9.1.

name: Poverty gap index
definition: Average shortfall of consumption below the poverty line, as a share of the line, averaged over the whole population (non-poor count as zero).
notes: Urban/rural use 2012 definitions.

name: Poverty gap index 2017 (modelled)
definition: Poverty gap for 2016/17 re-estimated on the EICV7 methodology.

name: Median consumption per adult equivalent
definition: Median annual consumption per adult equivalent, thousand RWF in January 2024 prices.

name: Median consumption per adult equivalent, 2017
definition: Median annual consumption per adult equivalent in 2016/17, thousand RWF in January 2024 prices.

name: Gini coefficient of consumption
definition: Inequality of consumption per adult equivalent (0 = perfect equality, 100 = maximal inequality).

name: Theil's T index
definition: General-entropy GE(1) inequality measure; decomposable into within- and between-group parts.

name: MPI incidence (H)
definition: Share of people identified as multidimensionally poor: deprived in at least one third (k = 33.3%) of the weighted indicators of Rwanda's national MPI.

name: MPI intensity (A)
definition: Average share of weighted deprivations experienced by multidimensionally poor people.

name: Multidimensional Poverty Index (M0 = H × A)
definition: Adjusted headcount ratio M0 = H × A (Alkire–Foster), Rwanda national MPI, 13 indicators in 4 dimensions.

name: Population share
definition: Share of national population living in the group, as reported alongside the MPI.

name: MPI incidence at alternative poverty cut-off k
short_name: MPI incidence at alternative poverty cut-off k
definition: Incidence H recomputed by NISR for poverty cut-offs k = 5%…100%.

name: MPI intensity at alternative k
definition: Intensity A at poverty cut-offs k = 5%…100%.

name: MPI at alternative k
definition: M0 at poverty cut-offs k = 5%…100%.

name: MPI × monetary poverty overlap
definition: Joint distribution of MPI status (k = 33.3%) and monetary status (national poverty line). Cells are shares of the national population.

name: Health insurance coverage
definition: Share of the population with any health insurance (community-based Mutuelle, RAMA, MMI, private, etc.).

name: Households living in planned rural settlement (umudugudu)
definition: Share of households whose habitat is an umudugudu (planned grouped settlement).

name: Metal / corrugated iron roofing
definition: Share of households whose dwelling has metal/corrugated iron sheet roofing.

name: Electricity as main lighting source
definition: Share of households using electricity (grid or solar) as the main source of lighting.

name: Internet access at home (incl. mobile)
definition: Share of households with internet access at home, including through mobile phones.

name: Improved drinking-water source
definition: Share of households using an improved drinking-water source (EICV definition; distance not applied).

name: Improved sanitation
definition: Share of households using improved sanitation facilities.

name: Household owns a mobile phone
definition: Share of households owning at least one mobile phone.

name: Household owns a smartphone
definition: Share of households owning at least one smartphone.

name: Workforce-to-population ratio
definition: Share of the working-age population that is in the workforce.

name: Households sending transfers to another household
definition: Share of households that sent cash, food or in-kind transfers to another household in the last 12 months.
notes: Measures inter-household support, not use of financial services.

name: Households sending cash transfers
definition: Share of households that sent cash transfers to another household in the last 12 months.
notes: Does not identify the channel (cash, mobile money or bank).

name: Average household size (EICV7)
definition: Mean number of household members.

name: Number of households (EICV7 estimate)
definition: Weighted estimate of households, thousands.

name: Private households (Census 2022)
definition: Number of private households enumerated in the Fifth Population and Housing Census (August 2022).

name: Mean private household size (Census 2022)
definition: Mean size of private households, Census 2022.

name: Household has at least one savings account
definition: Share of households in which at least one member has a savings account (EICV7, memo item in Poverty Profile Table 6.9).

name: Household has at least one mobile-money account
definition: Share of households with at least one MoMo / Mocash account (EICV7, memo item in Poverty Profile Table 6.9).

name: Main response to shocks
definition: Main way the household responded to its most severe shock.

name: Adults banked (FinScope Access Strand)
definition: Share of adults using a product from a commercial bank (Access Strand: banked).

name: Adults formally served, not banked
definition: Share of adults using non-bank formal products (mobile money, SACCO, MFI, insurance, pension) but not a bank.

name: Adults informally served only
definition: Share of adults using only informal mechanisms (e.g. savings groups) and no formal product.

name: Adults financially excluded
definition: Share of adults using neither formal nor informal financial products/mechanisms.

name: Adults formally served (banked + other formal)
definition: Banked + other formal (non-bank), computed from the transcribed Access Strand segments.

name: FinScope 2024 headline indicators
definition: Headline percentages stated in the FinScope Rwanda 2024 report text.

name: Households in VUP programmes
definition: Estimated number of households benefiting from VUP programmes.

name: Share of VUP households by component
short_name: Share of VUP households by component
definition: Distribution of households benefiting from VUP by component (with standard errors).

name: Households by VUP component
definition: Estimated number of households participating in each VUP component.

name: Poverty rate among VUP beneficiaries
definition: Monetary poverty rate among people in households benefiting from each VUP component.

name: VUP payments received via Umurenge SACCO
short_name: VUP payments received via Umurenge SACCO
definition: Share of beneficiaries whose most recent payment was received through an Umurenge SACCO account.

name: VUP payments received via mobile money
short_name: VUP payments received via mobile money
definition: Share of beneficiaries whose most recent payment was received through MoMo/Airtel Money.

name: VUP last payment received on time
short_name: VUP last payment received on time
definition: Share of beneficiaries whose last payment arrived on time.

name: VUP Financial Services loan approved
definition: Share of FS participants whose loan application was approved.

name: Average VUP Financial Services loan
definition: Average loan amount received per individual from the VUP Financial Services component.

name: Censored headcount — School attendance
definition: Share of people who are multidimensionally poor AND deprived in school attendance. Deprived if: At least one school-aged child (6–11 years) in the household is not attending school.

name: Uncensored headcount — School attendance
definition: Share of all people deprived in school attendance, regardless of MPI status. Deprived if: At least one school-aged child (6–11 years) in the household is not attending school.
notes: Table B.1 subtitle reads 'proportion of poor people', but the figure title and values describe all people (uncensored).

name: Published contribution to MPI — School attendance
definition: Percentage contribution of school attendance to M0 as printed in the MPI workbook.
notes: Cannot be reproduced from Table B.2 and the stated weights; see validation report.

name: Recomputed contribution to MPI — School attendance
definition: Contribution recomputed by Imboni as w_j × CH_j / Σ_i w_i × CH_i using official weights and censored headcounts.
table_ref: Derived from Tables B.2–B.4 + report weights
